**Finding: Compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

- No liquidated damages, penalty, or minimum/early-termination fee is imposed on Meridian anywhere in the Agreement — the preferred position, not merely the fallback.
- §9.4 lets us terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice, paying only for conforming Services rendered, with prepaid Fees refunded; §27.3 confirms force-majeure termination is "without penalty"; §7.3 bars interest on amounts ultimately found not due.
- The §2.1 take-or-pay commitment is a minimum-commitment problem handled under MINCOMMIT; I have not double-flagged it here.

No redline proposed.
